title: 15-Day Turkey Tour: Bodrum, Antalya & Cappadocia
metaTitle: Two Weeks in Turkey | Bodrum & Antalya Tour
metaDescription: Spend 15 days exploring Istanbul, Cappadocia, Bodrum, Ephesus, Pamukkale and Antalya, combining cultural highlights with time on Turkey's Aegean & Mediterranen.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
Turkey Tours & Packages 2026–2027 | Private & Small Group
summary:
The 15-Day Istanbul, Cappadocia, Bodrum, Antalya, Ephesus & Pamukkale Tour gives you time to explore Turkey’s cultural highlights while enjoying both its Aegean and Mediterranean coasts. Begin among Istanbul’s Ottoman and Byzantine landmarks, then fly to Cappadocia for its valleys, fairy chimneys and rock-cut settlements. Bodrum brings several days by the Aegean before the route continues through Ephesus, Pamukkale and Hierapolis to Antalya on the Mediterranean.
Rather than following a fixed departure calendar, the journey can be arranged around your preferred dates. We handle selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, three domestic flights, airport transfers and the guided sightseeing included along the route.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise & Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Flight to Bodrum Via Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Free time at leisure in Cappadocia
Transfer to Kayseri Airport for flight to Bodrum via Istanbul
Arrival transfer to hotel in Bodrum
Rest of the day is free at leisure. Overnight in Bodrum

itinerary.title: Free day in Bodrum
itinerary.text:
Free day at leisure in Bodrum. Explore the marina, beaches, and local bazaars
Optional visit to Bodrum Castle and the ruins of the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus
Enjoy the Aegean coast and seaside atmosphere. Overnight in Bodrum

itinerary.title: Free day in Bodrum
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Free day at leisure in Bodrum
Enjoy the beaches, marina, shops, and nightlife
Optional visits to local historical and cultural sites. Overnight in Bodrum

itinerary.title: Bodrum to Kusadasi
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, enjoy free time at leisure in Bodrum. Later, transfer to Kusadasi and check in to your hotel.
Rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Tour to Ephesus Ancient City
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale & Antalya
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, continue by intercity coach to Antalya. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Tour to Perge Aspendos and Kursunlu Wasterfall
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:00, enjoy a full-day tour of Antalya and the ancient Pamphylia region. Visit the ancient ruins of Perge, the remarkably preserved Roman theater of Aspendos, and the charming coastal town of Side with its historic ruins and seaside atmosphere. The tour also includes a stop at the scenic Manavgat Waterfall. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Enjoy a free day at leisure in Antalya. Later, transfer to Antalya Airport for your late afternoon flight to Istanbul.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Free day in Istanbul
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day to explore Istanbul at your own pace, with the option to visit local bazaars and the city’s modern districts. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Two-Week Turkey Travel Package?
faqs.a: The Two-Week Turkey Travel Package covers Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus, Pamukkale, Antalya, and Bodrum. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, discover Cappadocia's fairy chimneys and underground cities, visit the ancient ruins of Ephesus, experience Pamukkale's white travertine terraces, enjoy Antalya's Mediterranean coastline, and relax in the vibrant seaside resort town of Bodrum. The tour runs for 14 nights and 15 days.

faqs.q: How much does the Two-Week Turkey Travel Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,895 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes Three domestic flights. These flights help reduce travel time between regions, allowing you to comfortably experience Turkey's most important cultural, historical, and coastal destinations.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 14 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers throughout the itinerary are included.

faqs.q: Does the Two-Week Turkey Travel Package include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want a comprehensive introduction to Turkey. It combines ancient cities, natural wonders, unique landscapes, and beautiful coastal destinations, offering a well-rounded experience of the country's diverse attractions.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and areas with uneven terrain. Sites such as Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Cappadocia involve moderate walking, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Antalya and Bodrum?
faqs.a: Antalya is known for its beautiful Mediterranean coastline, Kaleiçi Old Town, waterfalls, and nearby ancient ruins. Bodrum is famous for its beaches, marina, Bodrum Castle, vibrant nightlife, and relaxed Aegean atmosphere, making it one of Turkey's most popular holiday destinations.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Two-Week Turkey Travel Package?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the Two-Week Turkey Travel Package available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include optional excursions, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
